categories.name: UI
categories.blurb: Working interfaces in text: apps, terminals, tools and system screens.

categories.name: Lettering
categories.blurb: Words that move: big letterforms, credits, tickers and reading effects.

categories.name: Algorithms
categories.blurb: Maths and code that draw: fractals, automata, attractors.

categories.name: Demoscene
categories.blurb: Classic demo effects: fire, plasma, tunnels and warps.

pieces.name: API Request Inspector
pieces.note: A request inspector where API calls stream in with method, path, status and timing bars, and one is opened to show its headers.

pieces.name: Apollonian Gasket
pieces.note: An Apollonian gasket of shaded pearls, every gap filled by smaller tangent circles, while the view glides in toward a tangency point and back out.

pieces.name: Aurora Curtains
pieces.note: Three folded ribbons of aurora, green, teal and rose, sway slowly across the whole sky while their rays drift along each curtain.

pieces.name: Benchmark Results
pieces.note: A benchmark runner that measures each case with a live iteration counter and fills a table of timings compared to the last baseline.

pieces.name: Firmware Setup Utility
pieces.note: A retro firmware setup screen where a cursor walks the tabs, enables a setting, reorders boot devices and saves.

pieces.name: Bisect Hunt
pieces.note: A bisect session that tests the middle commit, marks it good or bad and halves the range until the first bad commit is found.

pieces.name: Blinking Cursor
pieces.note: A minimal prompt in big block type where a short word is typed and erased beside a blinking block cursor.

pieces.name: Boids Over Meadow
pieces.note: A top-down boids flock steers by separation, alignment and cohesion, splitting and regrouping whenever a hunting hawk dives through.

pieces.name: Boot Sequence
pieces.note: A system boot log scrolls past with green OK tags, then the machine waits at a login prompt.

pieces.name: Bouncing Letters
pieces.note: Block letters drop in one at a time, bounce with a little squash and settle on the floor before falling away.

pieces.name: Breaking News Ticker
pieces.note: A live news graphic where a red breaking banner slides in, each headline types itself into the lower third and a ticker crawls underneath.

pieces.name: Brian's Brain
pieces.note: The Brian's Brain cellular automaton: firing cells turn refractory then rest, so gliders and spreading wavefronts sweep endlessly across the grid.

pieces.name: Burning Title
pieces.note: The word IGNITE glows like hot coals while turbulent flames curl up from every letter into the dark.

pieces.name: Calculator Keypad
pieces.note: A calculator where keys light up as they are pressed, the display builds an expression and the result rolls in on equals.

pieces.name: Calendar Month
pieces.note: A month calendar with coloured event dots, today marked, and a selection hopping between days with an agenda panel.

pieces.name: Chalkboard Lettering
pieces.note: A stick of chalk writes a big word on a dusty green board, underlines it, and a felt eraser wipes it away for the next one.

pieces.name: Chat Thread
pieces.note: A chat conversation where bubbles appear after a typing indicator and replies are typed in the composer.

pieces.name: Checkout Payment Flow
pieces.note: A checkout page fills shipping and card details, processes the payment and lands on a confirmed order.

pieces.name: Silent Film Title Card
pieces.note: An old projector reel counts down 3 2 1 with a sweeping leader, then lands on a framed THE END card full of grain, scratches and gate weave.

pieces.name: Clifford Attractor
pieces.note: A Clifford strange attractor drawn as a glowing density map, its four parameters drifting so the silky folds keep reshaping themselves.

pieces.name: Rolling Deployment
pieces.note: A cluster rolling update where new pods start, pass readiness and replace old ones while a status line counts up to a successful rollout.

pieces.name: Code Editor
pieces.note: An editor window with line numbers where a small rate limiter is typed out in syntax colours.

pieces.name: Space Colonisation Tree
pieces.note: A tree grows by the space colonisation algorithm, each branch reaching toward a cloud of attractor points that vanish as they are claimed, then bursts into leaf.

pieces.name: Color Picker Sliders
pieces.note: A colour picker where the hue strip, the shade field and the RGB sliders move together and the swatch and hex code follow.

pieces.name: Command Palette
pieces.note: A command palette drops over a dimmed editor, filters commands as a query is typed and runs the pick.

pieces.name: Compiler Warnings
pieces.note: A compiler build log that compiles dependencies, prints an unused variable warning with a pointed snippet and finishes green.

pieces.name: Constellation Lettering
pieces.note: On a drifting star chart, bright stars light up and are joined line by line until the constellation spells a word, then it fades into the next.

pieces.name: Countdown Timer
pieces.note: Big digits count down from ten inside a ring that drains every second, then GO bursts out in green.

pieces.name: Coverage Report
pieces.note: A code coverage report where per-file bars fill up, colour by threshold and then re-sort so the weakest files rise to the top.

pieces.name: CRT Test Card
pieces.note: An old CRT television showing a colour test card, the picture rolling slowly with visible scanlines.

pieces.name: Crystal Grain Growth
pieces.note: Crystals nucleate one by one in a cooling melt and grow outward until they lock together into a mosaic of grains, each with its own lattice angle.

pieces.name: Cylinder
pieces.note: A striped cylinder tumbling slowly in space, its curved side and flat caps lit and depth-sorted.

pieces.name: Data Table
pieces.note: A service status table that re-sorts by a new column every few seconds while a selection bar walks the rows.

pieces.name: Date Range Picker
pieces.note: A two month calendar where a start date is clicked, the range stretches with the cursor and the night count updates.

pieces.name: Decode Reveal
pieces.note: A field of cipher noise gives way column by column as a block letter phrase decrypts out of it.

pieces.name: Delivery Route Tracker
pieces.note: A delivery tracking screen where the route draws across a street grid, the courier moves along it and the order steps tick to delivered.

pieces.name: Departures Hall Board
pieces.note: A full airport departures board with times, flights, destinations, gates and statuses that flip as boarding opens, gates close and flights leave the list.

pieces.name: Dial-Up Handshake
pieces.note: A retro terminal program that dials out, shows the modem handshake as a noisy signal with front panel lights, connects and lands on a bulletin board.

pieces.name: Digital Clock
pieces.note: A big seven segment clock ticking through the seconds, with ghosted unlit segments and a blinking colon.

pieces.name: Partition Editor
pieces.note: A curses-style partition editor that carves a new partition out of free space, writes the table and formats it.

pieces.name: Diffusion Aggregation
pieces.note: Random walkers drift in from the dark and stick on contact, building a branching frost-like cluster one particle at a time.

pieces.name: DNS Resolver Chain
pieces.note: A DNS lookup diagram where a query packet hops from the client to the resolver, root, TLD and authoritative servers and the answer returns.

pieces.name: Double Helix
pieces.note: Two glossy strands twisting around each other like DNA, joined by coloured base pairs and depth-sorted as they turn.

pieces.name: Download Queue
pieces.note: A download manager where six files report size, speed and time left, then finish one by one.

pieces.name: Dragon Curve
pieces.note: A line folded in half over and over, each fold swinging out a new copy until the Heighway dragon appears.

pieces.name: End Credits Roll
pieces.note: Film end credits roll up a letterboxed screen, roles right-aligned against a centre gutter, names beside them and section headings in between.

pieces.name: Endless Corridor
pieces.note: A ray-cast flight down an infinite corridor, ceiling lamps, red doors and a glowing trim line rushing past.

pieces.name: Extruded Word Spin
pieces.note: A chunky 3D extruded word swings back and forth in space with a lit pink face and deep blue sides.

pieces.name: File Tree
pieces.note: A project explorer where a cursor walks the tree, opening and closing folders as it goes.

pieces.name: Fireworks
pieces.note: Rockets climbing over a night city skyline and bursting into coloured, falling shells.

pieces.name: Profiler Flame Graph
pieces.note: A CPU profiler flame graph whose stacks grow and settle as samples come in while a cursor inspects the hottest frames.

pieces.name: Flip Dot Board
pieces.note: A mechanical flip dot board whose yellow discs turn over in a sweeping wave each time it changes to the next word.

pieces.name: Flow Field
pieces.note: Hundreds of particles tracing streamlines through a noise flow field, coloured by the direction they travel.

pieces.name: Form Validation Errors
pieces.note: A form is submitted half filled, red errors drop in under each bad field, then each one is corrected until it submits clean.

pieces.name: Terminal Fortune Cookie
pieces.note: A shell command cracks open a fortune cookie in the terminal, a paper slip slides out with an original fortune and lucky numbers, then the screen clears for another.

pieces.name: Game of Life
pieces.note: Conway's Game of Life on a wrapping board, cells coloured by age, starting a fresh random board every 45 seconds, or sooner if it stalls.

pieces.name: Git Log Graph
pieces.note: A git log graph with feature branches merging back into main as new commits land on top.

pieces.name: Glitch Title Settle
pieces.note: A big title tears into sliding slices, splits into red and cyan channels and corrupted blocks, then settles into a crisp clean word.

pieces.name: Group Chat Transcript
pieces.note: A three-person group chat plans a weekend hike, bubbles stacking up with avatars, names, reactions and read receipts while the feed scrolls.

pieces.name: Gimbal Gyroscope
pieces.note: A gyroscope of three nested gold, steel and copper rings, each turning on its own pivot around a fast spinning rotor disc.

pieces.name: Heap Allocator Map
pieces.note: A memory allocator page map where blocks are allocated and freed, fragmentation builds up and a compaction pass packs it tight.

pieces.name: Heart 3D
pieces.note: A solid 3D heart surface beating slowly with a lub-dub pulse, turning a little side to side as small hearts drift up behind it.

pieces.name: Hilbert Curve
pieces.note: A fifth-order Hilbert curve drawing itself corner by corner in a rainbow, then reeling back in.

pieces.name: Holographic Grid Sphere
pieces.note: A see-through holographic globe of glowing grid lines turns above a projector pad while a ring of data blips orbits around it.

pieces.name: Hyperspace Jump
pieces.note: Calm stars stretch into streaks, the ship plunges into a swirling blue hyperspace tunnel and then drops back out among the stars.

pieces.name: Shattering Ice Letters
pieces.note: Frosted ice letters spelling CHILL take a hit, crack outward, shatter into falling shards and then freeze back from the ground up.

pieces.name: Icosahedron
pieces.note: A twenty-faced solid turning on two axes, every triangular facet lit flat in shades of teal.

pieces.name: Debugger Stepping
pieces.note: An editor debugger steps line by line through a loop, pausing on breakpoints while locals, watches and the call stack change.

pieces.name: Container Layer Pull
pieces.note: A container image pull where each layer downloads with its own progress bar, extracts and completes, ending with a digest.

pieces.name: Inbox List
pieces.note: An email inbox with unread dots, stars and previews, where new mail slides in at the top.

pieces.name: Infra Plan and Apply
pieces.note: An infrastructure-as-code plan that lists resources to add, change and destroy in coloured diffs, then applies them with elapsed timers.

pieces.name: Ink in Water
pieces.note: Drops of indigo, crimson and teal ink fall into clear water and bloom into curling mushroom plumes that slowly dissolve.

pieces.name: Install Log
pieces.note: A package manager install log resolving, fetching and linking packages, ending in a green summary.

pieces.name: Julia Set
pieces.note: A Julia set that morphs between spirals, dendrites and dust as its constant c traces the edge of the main cardioid.

pieces.name: Kaleidoscope
pieces.note: An eightfold mirrored pattern that turns and shifts colour like a kaleidoscope.

pieces.name: Kanban Board
pieces.note: A three column task board where cards lift, travel across and settle into place.

pieces.name: Karaoke Lyrics
pieces.note: Original song lyrics fill with colour syllable by syllable under a hopping ball, the next line waiting below and a level meter dancing along.

pieces.name: Keyboard Keypress
pieces.note: A keyboard where each key sinks and lights as a sentence is typed into the text field above it, shift and space included.

pieces.name: Kinetic Word Slam
pieces.note: Big words zoom in from the camera one beat at a time and slam into place with a screen shake and a burst of dust.

pieces.name: Klein Bottle
pieces.note: A Klein bottle turning slowly, its narrow neck curling back through the side to join the base, the two sides of the one surface lit violet and teal.

pieces.name: L-System Plant
pieces.note: A Lindenmayer system plant growing branch by branch from the soil, swaying in a breeze and blossoming before it regrows.

pieces.name: Langton's Ant
pieces.note: Four of Langton's ants share one wrapping board, each painting its own colour until order emerges from the chaos.

pieces.name: Laser Engraved Plate
pieces.note: A laser head rasters across a brushed steel plate, engraving the word CRAFT with white hot cuts that cool to dark grooves.

pieces.name: Lava Crust Cracks
pieces.note: Plates of cooled black crust drift down a lava river, molten orange light glowing up through the cracks as they pull apart.

pieces.name: Lava Lamp
pieces.note: A glowing lamp where blobs of warm wax rise, merge, split and sink through violet liquid.

pieces.name: LED Matrix Scroller
pieces.note: A shop window LED matrix sign with a dotted grid of dark LEDs scrolling a two colour message in a chunky pixel font.

pieces.name: Liquid Chrome
pieces.note: Mercury blobs drift, merge and split apart, shaded like polished chrome reflecting a bright sky and dark ground.

pieces.name: Liquid Fill Letters
pieces.note: Hollow glass letters spelling WATER fill up with sloshing blue liquid and rising bubbles, then drain and refill.

pieces.name: Lit Sphere
pieces.note: A shaded ball with red, yellow and blue panels turning on a tilted axis, with a bright glint and a soft floor shadow.

pieces.name: Login Form
pieces.note: A sign-in card where the email and password fill in, the button presses and a success tick draws itself.

pieces.name: Lorenz Butterfly
pieces.note: The Lorenz attractor turns slowly in 3D while a glowing comet traces its two butterfly wings, the full orbit drawn faintly behind in braille dots.

pieces.name: Maintenance Mode
pieces.note: A be right back page with a turning gear, a rocking wrench and a live list of upgrade steps.

pieces.name: Mandelbrot Zoom
pieces.note: A smooth colour zoom into the seahorse valley of the Mandelbrot set, diving deep and drifting back out.

pieces.name: Marquee Sign
pieces.note: A theatre marquee framed by chasing light bulbs, with big warm letters scrolling across the board.

pieces.name: Digital Rain
pieces.note: Columns of green glyphs falling at different speeds, each led by a bright white head.

pieces.name: Maze Builder
pieces.note: A maze carved cell by cell by a backtracking walker, flooded from the entrance, solved, then carved anew.

pieces.name: Merge Conflict Resolver
pieces.note: A three pane merge editor walks through conflicting hunks, accepting ours, theirs or both until the file is clean.

pieces.name: Metaballs
pieces.note: Glowing blobs drifting across the screen, merging and splitting like hot liquid.

pieces.name: Mobius Strip
pieces.note: A one-sided band with a half twist turning slowly, its colour shifting from teal to violet as it travels around the loop.

pieces.name: Modal Dialog
pieces.note: A delete confirmation dialog pops up over a dimmed settings page, takes a typed name and closes.

pieces.name: Modal Editor Session
pieces.note: A modal terminal text editor where the cursor hops, a line is deleted, a new one inserted, a search and replace runs and the file is saved.

pieces.name: Morse Signal
pieces.note: A phrase keyed out in morse code, the signal trace scrolling past a lamp while each letter decodes above it.

pieces.name: Neon Sign Flicker
pieces.note: A two line neon tube sign glowing on a brick wall, buzzing and flickering with one tired letter.

pieces.name: Request Waterfall
pieces.note: A browser network panel where requests appear as a page loads, each with queue, connect, wait and download segments on a waterfall.

pieces.name: Nixie Tube Clock
pieces.note: Six glass nixie tubes with glowing orange wire digits count the seconds, rolling through every cathode every ten seconds.

pieces.name: Octahedron
pieces.note: An eight-faced gem spinning on its axis and rocking gently, with faces lit in alternating violet and blue.

pieces.name: Odometer Counter
pieces.note: Six rolling digit wheels count up like a car odometer, every carry turning the next wheel over.

pieces.name: Onboarding Stepper
pieces.note: A setup wizard walks through four steps, filling fields, picking options and ticking the stepper rail as it goes.

pieces.name: OTP Code Entry
pieces.note: A two step verification screen where a six digit code is typed, shakes as wrong, is retyped and goes green.

pieces.name: Package Publish
pieces.note: A terminal packs a package, lists its files, publishes it to the registry, and the weekly downloads graph beside it starts to climb.

pieces.name: Packet Capture
pieces.note: A packet capture tool streaming colour-coded TCP, UDP, DNS and TLS packets with protocol counters and a hex dump of the selected packet.

pieces.name: Lost In Space 404
pieces.note: A not found page with a big glowing 404 and a lost satellite drifting through twinkling stars.

pieces.name: Server Error 500
pieces.note: A 500 error page with a smoking server rack, blinking fault lights and a retry countdown.

pieces.name: Particle Rain Lettering
pieces.note: Bright grains rain from the top and pile up into a big block word, hold for a beat, then pour off the bottom for the next word.

pieces.name: Password Strength Meter
pieces.note: A password field where each keystroke moves a strength meter from weak to strong and ticks off the rules.

pieces.name: Fountain Pen Lettering
pieces.note: A fountain pen draws a big word stroke by stroke in wet blue ink on ruled paper, then the page turns for the next word.

pieces.name: Penrose Growth
pieces.note: A Penrose tiling of thick and thin rhombuses assembles itself tile by tile, spreading outward from a seed point that moves each round.

pieces.name: Perspective Text Crawl
pieces.note: An opening text crawl of block letters slides away from the viewer toward a vanishing point, shrinking and dimming over a field of stars.

pieces.name: Pixel Fire
pieces.note: The classic demoscene fire, heat rising from a white hot base and breaking into flickering tongues.

pieces.name: Sine Plasma
pieces.note: A classic sine plasma, rainbow bands rolling and folding into each other.

pieces.name: Pod Autoscaler
pieces.note: A container cluster view where a traffic spike pushes CPU up, new pods spin up across the nodes, then scale back down as load eases.

pieces.name: Power-On Memory Count
pieces.note: A retro power-on self test that counts up memory, detects drives one by one and hands off to the boot loader.

pieces.name: Pull Request Merged
pieces.note: A pull request page where the checks turn green one by one, a review approves it and the merge button lands it, branch deleted.

pieces.name: Pricing Plan Toggle
pieces.note: A three plan pricing table where the billing switch flips between monthly and yearly, prices roll to the new numbers and a plan is picked.

pieces.name: Process Viewer Sort
pieces.note: An interactive process viewer with meter bars where the table slides into a new order as the sort column changes.

pieces.name: Process Task Manager
pieces.note: A task manager where per process CPU and memory numbers churn, rows slide to re-sort by load, and a runaway process gets ended.

pieces.name: Process Tree Live
pieces.note: A live process tree with branch lines where build workers and request handlers spawn in green, run and exit in red.

pieces.name: Progress Loader
pieces.note: Four terminal progress bars filling at their own pace, with percent and a spinner.

pieces.name: Puzzle Cube Turns
pieces.note: A three by three colour puzzle cube turning while its layers twist one quarter turn at a time, scrambling and then solving itself.

pieces.name: Pyramid
pieces.note: A square pyramid turning slowly above its shadow, each sandstone face lit flat with bright edges.

pieces.name: Quote Of The Day
pieces.note: A card rotates through original quotes, each sliding up and out as the next one rises into place, with page dots and a timer bar.

pieces.name: Written in Rain
pieces.note: A steady downpour where every drop passing through a hidden word lights up, so the word appears written in falling rain.

pieces.name: Rainbow Text
pieces.note: Chunky block letters with a full rainbow gradient sweeping across them and a bright glint passing through.

pieces.name: Rainbow Warp Road
pieces.note: A rainbow striped highway snakes away through deep space at warp speed, its colour bands rushing underfoot as stars streak past.

pieces.name: Ransom Note Cutouts
pieces.note: Big letters cut from magazines in clashing colours and sizes, taped on a desk, each one flipping over now and then for a fresh clipping.

pieces.name: Reaction Diffusion
pieces.note: Gray-Scott reaction diffusion growing coral, spots and mazes outward from a handful of seeds.

pieces.name: README Badge Row
pieces.note: A README's badge row where build turns passing, coverage climbs, downloads tick up and the star count rolls over.

pieces.name: Interactive Rebase Todo
pieces.note: An interactive rebase todo list where commits are squashed, reworded, dropped and reordered before the rebase replays them.

pieces.name: Relay Chat Channel
pieces.note: A terminal relay chat client where people join and leave a channel, chat with timestamps and the nick list updates beside them.

pieces.name: Release Published
pieces.note: A terminal tags v1.1.0, pushes it, and the release notes type themselves out with new features, fixes and thanks to contributors.

pieces.name: Star Button Click
pieces.note: A repository header with Watch, Fork and Star buttons: the cursor glides over, clicks Star, and the count ticks over to your number.

about.label: Description
about.default: Animated ASCII art for web pages, READMEs and terminals.

pieces.name: Drone Sign Crew
pieces.note: A crew of tiny drones ferries blocks from a depot to build a big OPEN sign on a blueprint, then carries it all back.

pieces.name: Rotating Cube
pieces.note: A solid cube tumbling on two axes, each face lit flat with a character ramp and crisp bright edges.

pieces.name: Dodecahedron
pieces.note: A solid dodecahedron tumbling on three axes, its twelve pentagon faces lit in blue, amber and green with crisp edges.

pieces.name: Rotating Star
pieces.note: A thick five-pointed gold star extruded in 3D, spinning on its axis and catching the light on its bevels.

pieces.name: Rotozoomer
pieces.note: The demoscene rotozoomer, a checkered XOR texture spinning and zooming in and out.

pieces.name: Rule 30
pieces.note: The rule 30 elementary cellular automaton growing from a single cell, its chaotic triangles scrolling upward.

pieces.name: Search Autocomplete
pieces.note: A search box where suggestions narrow and highlight with every keystroke, then a result is picked with the arrow keys.

pieces.name: Settings Toggles
pieces.note: A settings panel where a focus marker moves down the list, flipping switches and dragging sliders.

pieces.name: Sierpinski Triangle
pieces.note: The chaos game at work: a point hops halfway to random corners and a Sierpinski triangle appears out of the noise.

pieces.name: Skeleton Loader
pieces.note: Shimmering skeleton placeholders for a feed of cards that dissolve into the real content.

pieces.name: Letter Slot Reels
pieces.note: A lever pulls, five reels of big letters blur past and thunk to a stop one by one to spell a word, and coins rattle into the tray.

pieces.name: Smart Home Panel
pieces.note: A home dashboard where lights flip on room by room, the thermostat climbs to its target, the door locks and the energy graph scrolls.

pieces.name: Rising Smoke Rings
pieces.note: A brick chimney puffs out smoke rings that rise, widen, wobble and slowly thin away into a dusky sky.

pieces.name: Grinder Sparks
pieces.note: An angle grinder bites into a steel bar on a workbench, throwing a bright fan of sparks that arc down and bounce across the floor.

pieces.name: Spectrum Music Player
pieces.note: A music player window with bouncing spectrum bars, a moving progress bar and a playlist that advances track by track.

pieces.name: Sphere to Cube Morph
pieces.note: A turning solid that swells from a smooth ball into a sharp cube and back, each of its six sides painted its own colour.

pieces.name: Spinner Set
pieces.note: Twelve classic terminal spinners side by side, each labelled with its name and frame count.

pieces.name: Spinning Gold Coin
pieces.note: A thick gold coin with a raised star and a ridged rim spinning on its edge, its shadow stretching and shrinking on the floor below.

pieces.name: Spinning Torus
pieces.note: A lit ring turning slowly on two axes, shaded with a classic character ramp.

pieces.name: Spirograph
pieces.note: A toothed wheel rolls inside a ring, its pen tracing hypotrochoid curves layered in colour, then a fresh set begins.

pieces.name: Split Flap Board
pieces.note: An airport departures board where every tile flaps through the alphabet to show the next flights.

pieces.name: Split Pane Multiplexer
pieces.note: A terminal multiplexer split into a streaming server log, a live resource meter and a test watcher, with focus hopping between panes.

pieces.name: Spreadsheet Recalc
pieces.note: A budget spreadsheet where a cell is edited, its formula bar updates and the dependent totals flash as they recalculate.

pieces.name: Spring Coil
pieces.note: A steel coil spring hanging from a beam, stretching and recoiling under a turning weight, lit with a bright metallic glint.

pieces.name: SQL Query Runner
pieces.note: A database console types a SQL query with highlighting, runs it and fills a result grid with rows and timing.

pieces.name: Secure Shell Login
pieces.note: A remote shell session that accepts a host key, prints a welcome banner with system stats, runs two commands and logs out.

pieces.name: Star Rating Review
pieces.note: A review card where the cursor hovers across five stars, settles on a rating, writes a short review and posts it to the tally.

pieces.name: Starburst
pieces.note: Rainbow rays bursting from a white hot centre while rings pulse outward through them.

pieces.name: Stencil Spray Paint
pieces.note: A spray can zigzags over a card stencil taped to a brick wall, the stencil peels away to reveal the painted word, and a roller paints it over.

pieces.name: Subtitle Captions
pieces.note: A night rooftop scene plays in a video frame while timed captions appear with coloured speaker names, sound cues and a moving scrubber.

pieces.name: Syntax Highlight Pass
pieces.note: Code is typed into an editor as plain grey text, then the language is detected and syntax colour sweeps down the file line by line.

pieces.name: Synthwave Grid
pieces.note: A neon grid rushing toward a striped sunset sun, with purple hills on the horizon.

pieces.name: Tab Bar
pieces.note: An editor tab bar where the active underline slides between files and the content swaps beneath.

pieces.name: Teleprompter Script
pieces.note: A speech script scrolls up a prompter screen past a marked reading line, with stage cues, a recording light and a running timer.

pieces.name: Terminal Session
pieces.note: A shell session where commands are typed at a coloured prompt and their output streams back.

pieces.name: Terrain Mesh Flyover
pieces.note: A low flight over an endless gridded landscape, green valleys rising to rocky ridges and snowy peaks that sweep toward the camera under a dusk sky.

pieces.name: Tesseract
pieces.note: A four dimensional hypercube turning through the fourth axis, its inner and outer cubes swapping places as it projects down.

pieces.name: Test Suite Dots
pieces.note: A test runner that prints a dot per passing test across files, flags a failure with a diff and ends in a coloured summary.

pieces.name: Text Scramble
pieces.note: Random block letters churn and settle one slot at a time into a phrase, then scramble away into the next.

pieces.name: Toast Stack
pieces.note: Notification toasts slide into the corner of an app, stack up, count down and slide away.

pieces.name: Torus Knot
pieces.note: A glossy tube tied in a trefoil torus knot, turning slowly, lit and depth-sorted so it passes over and under itself.

pieces.name: Candy Trefoil Tube
pieces.note: A fat red and cream striped tube tied in a trefoil knot, the stripes flowing around the loop while the knot slowly turns.

pieces.name: Truchet Tiles
pieces.note: A grid of quarter-circle Truchet tiles turning in rippling waves, the tubes re-routing into new flowing paths.

pieces.name: Texture Tunnel
pieces.note: A flight down an endless checkered tunnel that bends and twists as it goes.

pieces.name: TV Static
pieces.note: An untuned television full of snowy static, a brighter bar rolling slowly down the screen.

pieces.name: Twin Pane Commander
pieces.note: A retro two-pane file manager where the cursor picks files, a copy dialog fills its progress bar and the files land in the other pane.

pieces.name: Typewriter
pieces.note: Big block letters typed one key at a time behind a block cursor, wrapping onto new lines before the page clears.

pieces.name: Unfolding Poem
pieces.note: An original poem is written out line by line behind a pen cursor, each letter settling from faint to full ink, then lifts away for the next poem.

pieces.name: Upload Dropzone
pieces.note: A cursor drags a stack of files onto a drop zone that lights up, then each file uploads with its own progress bar.

pieces.name: Vaporwave Sun
pieces.note: A striped retro sun sinks into a scrolling neon grid sea while cloud streaks drift past and a CRT roll bar slides down the screen.

pieces.name: Vertical Haiku Scroll
pieces.note: Original haiku are brushed onto a hanging scroll in vertical columns read right to left, finished with a red seal, while a leaf drifts past.

pieces.name: Voronoi Cells
pieces.note: Fourteen drifting seed points and the Voronoi regions they claim, shaded like moving stained glass.

pieces.name: Voxel Heart
pieces.note: A chunky heart built from small red cubes, turning slowly and giving a double beat every couple of seconds.

pieces.name: Pool Caustics
pieces.note: Shimmering networks of light dancing across the tiled floor of a swimming pool.

pieces.name: Wave Function Collapse
pieces.note: A terrain map is solved by wave function collapse, the lowest entropy tile collapsing first and every choice narrowing what its neighbours can become.

pieces.name: Wave Interference
pieces.note: Two vibrating sources send out circular waves that reinforce and cancel, carving the classic fan of nodal lines as the sources drift apart.

pieces.name: Wave Text
pieces.note: Big block letters bob along a travelling sine wave, brightening at each crest, with shadows that shrink as they rise.

pieces.name: Weather City Widget
pieces.note: A weather widget that slides from city to city, each with an animated sky icon, hourly temperatures and a five day outlook.

pieces.name: Window Tiling Manager
pieces.note: A desktop where windows open one by one and the tiling layout slides between halves, columns and a grid.

pieces.name: Wireframe City Flyby
pieces.note: A night flight down a long avenue between wireframe towers, cyan and magenta edges racing past over a gridded street.

pieces.name: Wireframe Globe
pieces.note: A wire sphere of latitude and longitude lines turning on a tilted axis, near lines bright and far lines dim behind.

pieces.name: Word Exchange
pieces.note: Everyday words trade like shares on a quote screen, with a crawling tape, a table of prices that tick up and down and a chart for the word of the hour.

pieces.name: Word Ladder Morph
pieces.note: A word ladder where one big letter at a time dissolves and re-forms into its neighbour, turning COLD into WARM while the steps are listed beside it.

pieces.name: World Map Pings
pieces.note: A dotted world map where live request pings flare up in cities and arcs carry traffic between them.
